Question: How do I reset my password?

Context:
[IT-PWD-01] Reset your password yourself
You can reset a forgotten or expired password without contacting the help desk, as long as multi-factor authentication (MFA) is already set up on your phone.

1. Go to https://id.smartdesk.example/reset.
2. Enter your work email address and choose **Forgot password**.
3. Approve the sign-in prompt in the SmartDesk Authenticator app, or type the 6-digit code it shows.
4. Choose a new password that meets the rules in IT-PWD-02 (Password rules and expiry).
5. Wait about 2 minutes, then sign in again.

After a reset, update the saved password everywhere it is stored: Outlook on your phone, the VPN client and any browser that remembered it. A stale saved password is the most common reason an account locks again right after a reset, because five wrong attempts lock it.

**Common problems.** If the account is locked, it unlocks by itself after 15 minutes. If the reset page says your email is not recognised, check you typed the full work address, not a personal one. If you no longer have your phone, you cannot use self-service; call the help desk on extension 4100. IT will ask your manager to confirm your identity, then set a temporary password that you must change at first sign-in.

[IT-SEC-01] Report a phishing email
If an email looks suspicious, treat it as phishing. Typical signs are an unexpected attachment, an urgent request for money or a password, a link whose address does not match the sender, or a sender name that does not match the address.

1. **Do not click links or open attachments.**
2. In Outlook, choose **Report** and then **Phishing**. This sends it to IT Security and removes it from your inbox.
3. If you cannot use the button, forward the email as an attachment (not a normal forward) to p***@smartdesk.example.
4. If you already clicked a link or typed your password, call Security on extension 4999 immediately, then reset your password at https://id.smartdesk.example/reset.

Report suspicious text messages and messages on Slack the same way, with a screenshot, to p***@smartdesk.example.

IT Security replies within 1 working day and sends a warning to all staff if the message is part of a wider campaign. If the email asked for a payment, also tell your manager and Finance. Reporting a phishing email, even a harmless one, is never penalised. Staying quiet about a click is what causes harm.

[IT-EQUIP-03] Lost or stolen laptop
If your laptop is lost or stolen, act in this order:

1. **Call Security on extension 4999 straight away**, at any hour. IT locks the device remotely and signs you out everywhere. Disk encryption protects the data, but your account still has to be secured.
2. **Report the theft to the police** if it was stolen, and keep the report number.
3. Raise a request at https://helpdesk.smartdesk.example within 24 hours with the date, place and what happened.
4. IT issues a replacement, usually within 2 working days.
5. Change your password at https://id.smartdesk.example/reset once you have the replacement.

**Interpretation points.**

- Prompt reporting matters most. Employees who report within 24 hours are not charged where the loss was not due to carelessness.
- If a laptop is lost through negligence, for example left unattended in a vehicle, the People Team and your manager review the case. The employee may be asked to cover part of the replacement cost, up to 50% of the depreciated value (company policy).
- Never wait to see whether the laptop turns up before reporting it. If it is found after you reported it, return it to IT; do not use it.
- If the laptop was lost while travelling on business, say so in the request. This is considered when deciding on any charge.

[IT-PWD-02] Password rules and expiry
SmartDesk AI passwords must:

- be at least **14 characters** long (a passphrase of several unrelated words is fine and easier to remember);
- not repeat any of your last 10 passwords;
- not contain your name, employee ID or work email address;
- not appear on the blocked list of commonly used passwords, which the reset page checks automatically.

Passwords expire every **180 days**. You get reminder emails 14 days and 3 days before expiry, and a sign-in banner in the final week. You can change the password early at any time at https://id.smartdesk.example/reset. After 5 wrong attempts the account locks for 15 minutes.

**What not to do.** Do not share your password with anyone, including IT staff; the help desk will never ask for it, by phone or email. Do not reuse your work password on any other website. A password manager is recommended; the approved one is available in the Software Centre.

If you think your password has been seen by someone else, reset it immediately and tell Security on extension 4999. Do not wait for it to expire.

[IT-MFA-01] Set up multi-factor authentication
MFA is mandatory for all email, VPN and portal sign-ins. You set it up once, on your first day or the first time you sign in. Allow about 10 minutes.

1. Install **SmartDesk Authenticator** on your phone from the App Store or Google Play.
2. On your computer, sign in at https://id.smartdesk.example/mfa with your work email and the temporary password from HR.
3. Choose **Add device**. A QR code appears.
4. In the app, choose **Add account** and scan the QR code.
5. Type the 6-digit code from the app to confirm.
6. Save the 10 backup codes shown on screen. Store them somewhere safe that is not the same phone, for example a password manager.

Push approval is the default: you tap **Approve** when signing in. If you have no mobile signal, open the app and type the 6-digit code instead.

**Common problems.** If the QR code will not scan, choose **Enter code manually** and type the key. If the code is rejected, check the phone's date and time are set to automatic, because the codes depend on correct time. Employees who cannot carry a phone at work can ask the help desk for a hardware security key.

Question: How many casual leave days do I get?

Context:
[HR-LEAVE-01] Casual leave entitlement
Every permanent employee gets **8 days of casual leave** per leave year. The leave year runs from 1 April to 31 March. Casual leave is meant for short, personal and often unplanned needs, such as a family errand or a personal appointment.

Rules:

- A single casual leave request can cover at most **3 consecutive working days**. For a longer absence, use earned leave.
- Half-day casual leave is allowed and counts as 0.5 day.
- Casual leave does **not** carry over. Unused days lapse on 31 March and are not paid out.
- Joiners get a pro-rated entitlement: 8 days multiplied by the months remaining in the leave year divided by 12, rounded up to the nearest half day.
- Casual leave cannot be attached directly before or after earned leave for a total of more than 3 consecutive days off, unless your manager approves.

Casual leave needs your manager's approval, ideally 2 working days ahead. In a genuine emergency you can apply on the same day, but you must tell your manager by 10:00. Apply in the people portal at https://people.smartdesk.example under **Leave**; the steps are in HR-LEAVE-04 (Apply for leave in the people portal).

Casual leave is available from your first day, including during probation.

[HR-PROB-02] Taking leave during probation
Probation does not stop you taking leave, but some leave types work differently while it lasts.

- **Casual leave and sick leave:** available from day one. Casual leave is pro-rated for the part of the year you are employed.
- **Earned leave:** it accrues from your first month at 1.5 days per month, but you cannot use it until you are confirmed. In a genuine emergency, your manager and the People Team can approve earned leave in advance, using what you have accrued so far.
- **Parental leave:** subject to its own eligibility rules, not to confirmation. See HR-LEAVE-06 (Maternity leave) and HR-LEAVE-07 (Paternity and adoption leave).

**How absence affects probation.** If your total unplanned absence during probation exceeds 15 working days, your probation is normally extended by the number of days over 15, so the reviewers have enough time to assess you. Approved sick leave with a medical certificate for a serious illness can be treated as an exception; the People Team decides.

**Interpretation example.** If you join on 1 June and take 3 casual days in July, those days do not change your probation end date. If you are away for 20 working days in total, your probation could be extended by 5 days.

Applying for leave works the same way as for everyone else; see HR-LEAVE-04 (Apply for leave in the people portal).

[HR-LEAVE-06] Maternity leave
SmartDesk AI provides paid maternity leave on full pay to employees who give birth.

- **First and second child:** **26 weeks**. Up to 8 of those weeks can be taken before the expected delivery date, and the rest after.
- **Third child onward:** **12 weeks**, of which up to 6 weeks can be taken before the expected delivery date.
- **Miscarriage or medical termination of pregnancy:** **6 weeks**, starting from the date it happens, with a medical certificate.

Eligibility: you must have worked at least **80 days** in the 12 months before the expected delivery date. Probation does not stop you qualifying if you meet the 80-day condition.

How to apply:

1. Tell your manager and the People Team (extension 4200) as early as you comfortably can, ideally **8 weeks before** your planned start date.
2. Apply under **Leave**, then **Maternity** in the people portal at https://people.smartdesk.example and upload the medical certificate with the expected delivery date.
3. The People Team confirms your dates and your cover plan within 5 working days.

If your baby arrives earlier than planned, tell the People Team as soon as you can and the leave starts from the date of birth. You can add earned leave or unused casual leave directly after maternity leave if you wish. Leave taken is not treated as a break in service, and your reviews and stock-option vesting continue during leave.

[HR-LEAVE-08] Compensatory off for extra hours
A **compensatory off (comp-off)** is a day off in return for approved work done on a weekend or public holiday, or for an extended period of work well beyond normal hours, for example during a customer outage.

Rules:

- Comp-off is **not automatic**. Your manager must approve the extra work in advance, or confirm it in writing within 2 working days afterwards.
- Working a full day on a weekend or public holiday earns **1 comp-off day**. Four to six hours earns a half-day.
- After approval you must **record the credit in the people portal** under **Leave**, then **Comp-off credit**. An email approval alone is not enough, and the day cannot be taken until the portal shows the credit as approved.
- A comp-off day must be used within **45 days** of the date it was earned. After that it lapses and cannot be carried forward or paid out.
- Comp-off can be combined with other leave, but not with more than **3 leave types** in one continuous absence, for example comp-off with casual and earned leave.

Interpretation points:

- Normal overtime on weekdays, for example staying an extra hour, does not earn comp-off. Teams are expected to plan work to fit regular hours.
- If you forget to record the credit within the 45 days, the day is lost, even if your manager approved the work.
- Extended hours during a major incident may be compensated more flexibly at the discretion of your department head; ask your manager.

[HR-LEAVE-02] Sick leave and medical certificates
You get **10 days of sick leave** per leave year (1 April to 31 March). Use it when you are too unwell to work or must care for a sick immediate family member.

Notifying and applying:

- Tell your manager by **10:00 on the first day** by phone or Slack. Do not rely on email alone.
- Record the leave in the people portal as soon as you are back, or within 2 working days if you are away longer.

Medical certificates:

- Up to **2 consecutive working days** of sick leave need no certificate.
- From the **3rd consecutive day**, you must upload a certificate from a registered doctor in the portal. It must cover the full period and should show the dates. It does not need to state the diagnosis.
- A certificate is also required for any sick day immediately before or after a weekend or public holiday if the total absence reaches 3 days.

Unused sick leave does not carry over, and it is not paid out when you leave. If you have used all 10 days and still need time off, your manager and the People Team can agree to charge the extra days to earned leave. If you are away for a long illness, contact the People Team on extension 4200 so they can explain your options in confidence.

Question: when is my salary paid?

Context:
[HR-PAY-01] Pay-day schedule and holiday exceptions
Salaries are paid monthly, on the **last working day of the month**, directly to the bank account registered in the people portal. The payslip is published in the portal by the **2nd** of the following month.

Exceptions and details:

- If the last day of the month falls on a weekend or a public holiday, salary is paid on the **previous working day**.
- Bank transfers usually arrive on the same day, but can take up to one more working day, depending on your bank.
- The payroll cut-off for changes such as new bank details or tax declaration changes is the **20th** of each month. Changes received after that apply from the following month.
- **New joiners:** if you join on or before the 20th, you are paid pro-rata for the days worked in your first month with that month's salary. If you join after the 20th, those days are paid with the next month's salary.
- **Leavers:** the final settlement, including unused earned leave and any deductions, is paid within 45 days of your last working day, after the equipment return in IT-EQUIP-04 (Returning equipment when you leave) is confirmed.

If your salary has not arrived by the second working day of the month, check your payslip first and then contact Payroll: extension 4250, direct line [PHONE], or p***@smartdesk.example. Please include your employee ID and the amount you expected.

[HR-SAL-01] Salary structure explained
Your offer letter states your **annual CTC** (cost to company). It is split into these components:

- **Basic pay:** **40% of CTC**. Many other items are calculated from it.
- **House rent allowance (HRA):** **20% of CTC**, paid monthly. It can reduce tax if you pay rent and chose the old regime.
- **Special allowance:** the balance of the fixed pay after basic, HRA and the other items below.
- **Employer provident fund:** the company pays **12% of basic** into your provident fund. You contribute a matching 12%, which is deducted from your pay.
- **Group insurance:** the cost of the health, life and accident cover the company provides to you.
- **Annual performance bonus:** a variable amount, paid with the June salary, based on the rating in the performance review and the company's results. The target is shown in your offer letter as a percentage of fixed pay.

**Monthly take-home** is the fixed pay after deductions: your provident fund contribution, income tax at source and, if applicable, extra benefit premiums. This is why your take-home is lower than CTC divided by 12.

To see your own breakdown, open **Pay**, then **Compensation** in the people portal at https://people.smartdesk.example. Questions about how a figure is calculated go to Payroll at p***@smartdesk.example.

[HR-PERF-01] Performance review cycle and calendar
The SmartDesk AI performance cycle follows the financial year, from **1 April to 31 March**.

Calendar:

- **By 30 April:** you and your manager agree your goals for the year in the people portal at https://people.smartdesk.example under **Performance**.
- **October:** mid-year check-in. A conversation about progress, feedback and any changes to goals. There is no rating at this stage.
- **February:** self-assessment opens, where you write what you achieved against each goal. It closes on 28 February.
- **March:** your manager writes their assessment and discusses it with you. Ratings are calibrated across the department.
- **April:** you receive your final rating and outcome, together with salary and bonus decisions.

How it works: goals should be specific and measurable, with at most five. You can update goals during the year with your manager's agreement. Feedback from two or three colleagues is collected for the annual review, but your manager is responsible for the final assessment.

If you disagree with your rating, you can ask for a review by the next-level manager and the People Team within 10 working days of receiving it. The decision is final.

Questions go to the People Team at p***@smartdesk.example or extension 4200.

[HR-TAX-01] Submit your tax declaration
Payroll deducts income tax at source each month, based on your declared choices for the year. The following is how to submit your tax declaration; it is not tax advice.

1. **Choose your regime by 30 April.** In the people portal, open **Pay**, then **Tax declaration**, and choose the old or new tax regime. If you do not choose, the new regime is applied.
2. **Declare your investments and claims** if you chose the old regime, such as insurance premiums and home loan interest. You can edit the declaration until **31 January**.
3. **House rent:** if you claim rent allowance, enter your landlord's details, and the PAN of the landlord if the annual rent is above ₹1,00,000.
4. **Submit proof between 1 February and 15 March.** Upload receipts and certificates in the same screen. Declarations without proof are not accepted.
5. Payroll reviews the proof and updates the tax for the final months of the year.

If you miss the proof deadline, tax is recalculated and deducted at the higher rate from the March salary. You can still claim any missing deduction yourself when you file your own return.

New joiners declare within 30 days of joining, and tell Payroll about tax already deducted by a previous employer using the previous employer's tax certificate. For questions, contact p***@smartdesk.example or extension 4250.

[HR-REIMB-01] Submit an expense claim
Business expenses that have been approved are refunded through the expenses portal at https://expenses.smartdesk.example.

1. Sign in with your work account.
2. Choose **New claim** and add one line for each expense, with the date, amount, category and a short business reason.
3. Attach the receipt or invoice for each line. Receipts are mandatory for anything over **₹500**; for amounts at or below ₹500 a short note is enough.
4. Choose your approver (normally your manager) and submit.

Timing and payment:

- Submit within **30 days** of the spend. Claims older than 30 days need approval from your department head.
- Approved claims are paid with the next salary run if approved by the **20th** of the month. Later approvals are paid with the following month's salary.
- Reimbursements appear as a separate line on your payslip.

**Common reasons for rejection.** A missing or unreadable receipt, a category that does not match the receipt, or spend above the limits in HR-REIMB-02 (Travel and daily allowance limits). Claims in foreign currency need the card statement showing the rupee amount. Duplicate claims are rejected automatically.

If a claim is rejected, the approver adds a reason and you can correct and resubmit it. For payment problems, contact Finance at e***@smartdesk.example.

5. **The VPN drops after about 10 minutes.** Update the client in the Software Centre. Versions below 5.2 have a known session timeout bug.

SmartDesk AI uses the **SmartDesk Connect** VPN client on company laptops. It is preinstalled; if it is missing, install it from the Software Centre.

1. Open **SmartDesk Connect**.
2. In **Server**, enter `vpn.smartdesk.example`. On managed laptops the profile "SmartDesk-Corp" is already set up and you only need to select it.
3. Sign in with your work email and password.
4. Approve the MFA prompt in SmartDesk Authenticator, or enter the 6-digit code.
5. The status turns green and shows "Connected". Internal sites such as https://people.smartdesk.example and the file shares now work.

To disconnect, choose **Disconnect** in the client; closing the window leaves the tunnel running.

The client is available for Windows, macOS and Ubuntu. Personal devices cannot be given VPN access, and you should not install the client on one even if it installs without error.

If the profile is missing after an update, choose **Add profile**, use the server name above and the profile name "SmartDesk-Corp". If the client asks for a certificate, restart the laptop once so the company certificate loads, then try again.

Every new employee receives the following on or before day one:

- a company laptop (a 14-inch standard model, or a 16-inch high-performance model for engineering and data roles);
- a power adapter and carry sleeve;
- a USB-C docking station;
- a wireless keyboard and mouse;
- a managed user account, with access to SmartDesk Authenticator for multi-factor authentication.

The laptop arrives with disk encryption, the VPN client and the standard software already installed, so you can sign in and start working.

**How it is arranged.** The People Team confirms your start date to IT at least 5 working days ahead, and IT prepares the kit. On day one you collect it from the IT counter on the ground floor (Bengaluru) or the IT store (Pune). Remote employees outside these cities receive the same kit by courier; the tracking details are sent to the personal email address you gave when accepting the offer.

If your role needs a different laptop model, for example for specialised data work, your manager requests it before your start date at https://helpdesk.smartdesk.example.

Contractors receive a laptop only when their contract says so. Equipment stays the property of SmartDesk AI and must be returned when you leave.

Question: can I claim my home broadband?

Context:
[HR-REIMB-03] Is home internet or a coworking space reimbursable?
**Home internet: yes, but as a fixed monthly allowance.** Employees on the hybrid model receive **₹1,000 per month** towards a home internet connection. Claim it once a month in the expenses portal at https://expenses.smartdesk.example under the category **Home internet**, with a copy of that month's bill in your name or a family member's. If your bill is lower than ₹1,000, you receive the actual amount. Only one connection is covered, even if you have two.

**Coworking space: no.** Fees for coworking or shared workspaces are not reimbursable, even on a day you work from home or from another city. The exception is a space IT or your department head asked you to use for a business need, approved in advance.

**Mobile data, electricity and equipment: no.** The allowance is the only home-working support. Furniture and equipment you buy yourself are not reimbursed.

Interpretation points:

- If you work from another city under the approved request, you can still claim the allowance for the month, based on the bill of the connection you used.
- If you are on leave for the full month, you cannot claim the allowance.
- Employees who are office-based full-time are not covered by the allowance.

[HR-TAX-01] Submit your tax declaration
Payroll deducts income tax at source each month, based on your declared choices for the year. The following is how to submit your tax declaration; it is not tax advice.

1. **Choose your regime by 30 April.** In the people portal, open **Pay**, then **Tax declaration**, and choose the old or new tax regime. If you do not choose, the new regime is applied.
2. **Declare your investments and claims** if you chose the old regime, such as insurance premiums and home loan interest. You can edit the declaration until **31 January**.
3. **House rent:** if you claim rent allowance, enter your landlord's details, and the PAN of the landlord if the annual rent is above ₹1,00,000.
4. **Submit proof between 1 February and 15 March.** Upload receipts and certificates in the same screen. Declarations without proof are not accepted.
5. Payroll reviews the proof and updates the tax for the final months of the year.

If you miss the proof deadline, tax is recalculated and deducted at the higher rate from the March salary. You can still claim any missing deduction yourself when you file your own return.

New joiners declare within 30 days of joining, and tell Payroll about tax already deducted by a previous employer using the previous employer's tax certificate. For questions, contact p***@smartdesk.example or extension 4250.

[HR-LEAVE-07] Paternity and adoption leave
SmartDesk AI offers the following leave to parents who are not giving birth, and to adopting parents. Paternity leave, second-parent adoption leave and adoptive-father leave are **company policy** and not a statutory right.

- **Paternity leave:** **2 weeks** on full pay, for a new father or partner of the person giving birth. It can be taken in one block or split into two blocks, any time within **6 months of the child's birth**.
- **Adoption leave, primary caregiver:** **12 weeks** on full pay for the main caregiver of a child under 3 months old. This applies to adoptive mothers, commissioning mothers, and to adoptive fathers and same-gender parents who are the main caregiver. [HR-LEAVE-05] Falling sick during earned leave, and how half-days count
This entry covers two common questions.

**If I fall sick while on earned leave, can I convert the days to sick leave?** Yes, with conditions:

- You must tell your manager on the first day you are sick, by 10:00.
- You must have **3 or more consecutive sick days**, and you must upload a medical certificate covering them within 2 working days of returning.
- The People Team then changes those days from earned to sick leave and restores the earned leave to your balance. Fewer than 3 days, or a missing certificate, stay as earned leave.
- Conversion is limited to the sick leave you still have. Any days beyond that remain earned leave.

**How do half-days count?**

- A half-day counts as 0.5 day of whatever leave type you choose.
- Two half-days on different dates count as two separate half-days, not one full day.
- A half-day at the start or end of a block of earned leave is allowed.
- A half-day of leave means you work the other half; you cannot combine a half-day of leave with another half-day of a different leave type on the same day unless the People Team approves it.

**Weekends in between.** A weekend or public holiday inside a block of leave is not counted. A weekend between two separate leave requests is also not counted, but your manager may ask whether the two requests should be one.

[HR-LEAVE-01] Casual leave entitlement
Every permanent employee gets **8 days of casual leave** per leave year. The leave year runs from 1 April to 31 March. Casual leave is meant for short, personal and often unplanned needs, such as a family errand or a personal appointment.

Rules:

- A single casual leave request can cover at most **3 consecutive working days**. For a longer absence, use earned leave.
- Half-day casual leave is allowed and counts as 0.5 day.
- Casual leave does **not** carry over. Unused days lapse on 31 March and are not paid out.
- Joiners get a pro-rated entitlement: 8 days multiplied by the months remaining in the leave year divided by 12, rounded up to the nearest half day.
- Casual leave cannot be attached directly before or after earned leave for a total of more than 3 consecutive days off, unless your manager approves.

Casual leave needs your manager's approval, ideally 2 working days ahead. In a genuine emergency you can apply on the same day, but you must tell your manager by 10:00. Apply in the people portal at https://people.smartdesk.example under **Leave**; the steps are in HR-LEAVE-04 (Apply for leave in the people portal).

Casual leave is available from your first day, including during probation.

[HR-LEAVE-02] Sick leave and medical certificates
You get **10 days of sick leave** per leave year (1 April to 31 March). Use it when you are too unwell to work or must care for a sick immediate family member.

Notifying and applying:

- Tell your manager by **10:00 on the first day** by phone or Slack. Do not rely on email alone.
- Record the leave in the people portal as soon as you are back, or within 2 working days if you are away longer.

Medical certificates:

- Up to **2 consecutive working days** of sick leave need no certificate.
- From the **3rd consecutive day**, you must upload a certificate from a registered doctor in the portal. It must cover the full period and should show the dates. It does not need to state the diagnosis.
- A certificate is also required for any sick day immediately before or after a weekend or public holiday if the total absence reaches 3 days.

Unused sick leave does not carry over, and it is not paid out when you leave. If you have used all 10 days and still need time off, your manager and the People Team can agree to charge the extra days to earned leave. If you are away for a long illness, contact the People Team on extension 4200 so they can explain your options in confidence.

[HR-STOCK-02] Stock options when you resign or are laid off
What happens to your options depends on how much has vested when your employment ends.

- **Vested options** can be exercised within **90 days** of your last working day. You pay the exercise price and any tax due. After 90 days they lapse.
- **Unvested options** lapse on your last working day. Vesting does not continue after you leave.
- **Notice period counts.** Vesting continues during your notice period, so options that vest during the 60 days are yours to exercise.

Interpretation points:

- **Resigning before the 1-year cliff:** you have no vested options, so nothing can be exercised. Resigning one day before the cliff gives you nothing; one day after gives you 25%.
- **Layoff:** the treatment is the same as resignation, except that if the notice is paid in lieu of working, vesting counts up to the end of the notice period.
- **Dismissal for serious misconduct:** all options, including vested ones, can be forfeited by decision of the board.
- **Moving to a role with no options:** vested options stay yours. Unvested ones continue to vest while you are employed.

To exercise, use **Equity**, then **Exercise** in the people portal before the 90 days end. Payment of the exercise price and tax is made by bank transfer. Leavers lose portal access after their last day, so exercise requests are made by email to e***@smartdesk.example. Contact the People Team on extension 4200 with questions.

- If the laptop connects but has no internet, disconnect and reconnect once, then restart the laptop.
- If you see a certificate warning, do not accept it; raise a request, because it may mean an impostor network with a similar name.

Wi-Fi speed problems in a particular office area should be reported through the portal with the floor and the nearest meeting-point landmark, so IT can check the access point.

[IT-MFA-01] Set up multi-factor authentication
MFA is mandatory for all email, VPN and portal sign-ins. You set it up once, on your first day or the first time you sign in. Allow about 10 minutes.

1. Install **SmartDesk Authenticator** on your phone from the App Store or Google Play.
2. On your computer, sign in at https://id.smartdesk.example/mfa with your work email and the temporary password from HR.
3. Choose **Add device**. A QR code appears.
4. In the app, choose **Add account** and scan the QR code.
5. Type the 6-digit code from the app to confirm.
6. Save the 10 backup codes shown on screen. Store them somewhere safe that is not the same phone, for example a password manager.

Push approval is the default: you tap **Approve** when signing in. If you have no mobile signal, open the app and type the 6-digit code instead.

**Common problems.** If the QR code will not scan, choose **Enter code manually** and type the key. If the code is rejected, check the phone's date and time are set to automatic, because the codes depend on correct time. Employees who cannot carry a phone at work can ask the help desk for a hardware security key.

Every new employee receives the following on or before day one:

- a company laptop (a 14-inch standard model, or a 16-inch high-performance model for engineering and data roles);
- a power adapter and carry sleeve;
- a USB-C docking station;
- a wireless keyboard and mouse;
- a managed user account, with access to SmartDesk Authenticator for multi-factor authentication.

The laptop arrives with disk encryption, the VPN client and the standard software already installed, so you can sign in and start working.

**How it is arranged.** The People Team confirms your start date to IT at least 5 working days ahead, and IT prepares the kit. On day one you collect it from the IT counter on the ground floor (Bengaluru) or the IT store (Pune). Remote employees outside these cities receive the same kit by courier; the tracking details are sent to the personal email address you gave when accepting the offer.

Contractors receive a laptop only when their contract says so. Equipment stays the property of SmartDesk AI and must be returned when you leave.

[IT-VPN-03] When the VPN is required, and split tunnelling
The VPN is **required** whenever you are off the SmartDesk AI office network and need an internal system: the code repositories, the finance and HR portals, internal file shares or customer data. It is **not** needed for email, chat or video calls, which are reachable directly after MFA.

The VPN uses **split tunnelling**. Only traffic for company systems goes through the tunnel; streaming and general browsing use your own connection. This keeps calls smooth and does not reduce security for company data.

Interpretation points:

- If you are on a home or coworking network and are unsure whether a system needs the VPN, assume it does. Connecting when it is not needed does no harm.
- Using the VPN does not make a personal device acceptable. Company data may only be opened on company-managed laptops, whatever the connection.
- Turning the VPN off while customer data is open, for example to join a call, is not permitted. Close the data first.
- Inside the Bengaluru and Pune offices you are on the corporate network already, so the VPN is not needed. It is harmless but will slow your connection.
- On public Wi-Fi such as airports, connect to the VPN before opening anything internal.
- Idle VPN sessions end automatically after 8 hours, so reconnect at the start of each working day.

Questions about a specific system go to IT Security at s***@smartdesk.example.

Guests use the **SmartDesk-Guest** network. It is separate from the corporate network and provides internet access only.

1. The visitor connects to **SmartDesk-Guest** on their phone or laptop and opens any website. The sign-in page appears.
2. The visitor enters their name and the **sponsor's work email**. The sponsor is the SmartDesk AI employee they are visiting.
3. The sponsor receives an approval email and clicks **Approve**.
4. Access is granted for 24 hours.

Employees can extend a guest's access up to 7 days by raising a request at https://helpdesk.smartdesk.example with the guest's name and the dates. For visits longer than 7 days, ask your manager to request a contractor account instead.

**Common problems.** If the sign-in page does not appear, open `http://neverssl.com` or any plain `http` page, because some browsers skip the sign-in page on secure sites. If the approval email does not arrive, check the sponsor's spam folder and confirm the sponsor's address was typed correctly.

Do not give visitors the corporate Wi-Fi details, and do not connect their devices to the corporate network or plug them into office network ports.

Context:

- You must tell your manager on the first day you are sick, by 10:00.
- You must have **3 or more consecutive sick days**, and you must upload a medical certificate covering them within 2 working days of returning.
- The People Team then changes those days from earned to sick leave and restores the earned leave to your balance. Fewer than 3 days, or a missing certificate, stay as earned leave.
- Conversion is limited to the sick leave you still have. Any days beyond that remain earned leave.

**How do half-days count?**

- A half-day counts as 0.5 day of whatever leave type you choose.
- Two half-days on different dates count as two separate half-days, not one full day.
- A half-day at the start or end of a block of earned leave is allowed.
- A half-day of leave means you work the other half; you cannot combine a half-day of leave with another half-day of a different leave type on the same day unless the People Team approves it.

**Weekends in between.** A weekend or public holiday inside a block of leave is not counted. A weekend between two separate leave requests is also not counted, but your manager may ask whether the two requests should be one.

You get **10 days of sick leave** per leave year (1 April to 31 March). Use it when you are too unwell to work or must care for a sick immediate family member.

- Tell your manager by **10:00 on the first day** by phone or Slack. Do not rely on email alone.

- Up to **2 consecutive working days** of sick leave need no certificate.
- From the **3rd consecutive day**, you must upload a certificate from a registered doctor in the portal. It must cover the full period and should show the dates. It does not need to state the diagnosis.
- A certificate is also required for any sick day immediately before or after a weekend or public holiday if the total absence reaches 3 days.

If you no longer have your phone, you cannot use self-service; call the help desk on extension 4100. IT will ask your manager to confirm your identity, then set a temporary password that you must change at first sign-in.

[IT-SEC-01] Report a phishing email
If an email looks suspicious, treat it as phishing. Typical signs are an unexpected attachment, an urgent request for money or a password, a link whose address does not match the sender, or a sender name that does not match the address.

1. **Do not click links or open attachments.**
2. In Outlook, choose **Report** and then **Phishing**. This sends it to IT Security and removes it from your inbox.
3. If you cannot use the button, forward the email as an attachment (not a normal forward) to p***@smartdesk.example.

IT Security replies within 1 working day and sends a warning to all staff if the message is part of a wider campaign. If the email asked for a payment, also tell your manager and Finance. 2. **Report the theft to the police** if it was stolen, and keep the report number.

- Never wait to see whether the laptop turns up before reporting it. If it is found after you reported it, return it to IT; do not use it.
- If the laptop was lost while travelling on business, say so in the request. This is considered when deciding on any charge.

If you think your password has been seen by someone else, reset it immediately and tell Security on extension 4999. Do not wait for it to expire.

1. Install **SmartDesk Authenticator** on your phone from the App Store or Google Play.
2. On your computer, sign in at https://id.smartdesk.example/mfa with your work email and the temporary password from HR.
3. Choose **Add device**. A QR code appears.
4. In the app, choose **Add account** and scan the QR code.
5. Type the 6-digit code from the app to confirm.
6. Save the 10 backup codes shown on screen. Store them somewhere safe that is not the same phone, for example a password manager.

Push approval is the default: you tap **Approve** when signing in. If you have no mobile signal, open the app and type the 6-digit code instead.

- Joined on or after **1 October**: you are not rated for that cycle. You still have a check-in conversation with your manager and goals for the rest of the year, and your first rating comes in the next cycle.

- If you spent more than 6 months in the previous team, the previous manager's input has equal weight on the part of the year that is theirs.
- Goals from the old team that you did not complete are agreed with both managers.

**If you were away for a long period.** Extended leave, such as maternity leave, does not lower your rating. Your goals are adjusted for the months you worked, and the rating is based on those months.

For borderline dates, such as joining on 1 October, the People Team makes the decision. Contact them at p***@smartdesk.example if your case is unclear.

[HR-PROB-02] Taking leave during probation
Probation does not stop you taking leave, but some leave types work differently while it lasts.

- **Casual leave and sick leave:** available from day one. Casual leave is pro-rated for the part of the year you are employed.
- **Earned leave:** it accrues from your first month at 1.5 days per month, but you cannot use it until you are confirmed. In a genuine emergency, your manager and the People Team can approve earned leave in advance, using what you have accrued so far.
- **Parental leave:** subject to its own eligibility rules, not to confirmation. See HR-LEAVE-06 (Maternity leave) and HR-LEAVE-07 (Paternity and adoption leave).

**How absence affects probation.** If your total unplanned absence during probation exceeds 15 working days, your probation is normally extended by the number of days over 15, so the reviewers have enough time to assess you. Approved sick leave with a medical certificate for a serious illness can be treated as an exception; the People Team decides.

**Interpretation example.** If you join on 1 June and take 3 casual days in July, those days do not change your probation end date. If you are away for 20 working days in total, your probation could be extended by 5 days.

Applying for leave works the same way as for everyone else; see HR-LEAVE-04 (Apply for leave in the people portal).

[HR-LEAVE-01] Casual leave entitlement
Every permanent employee gets **8 days of casual leave** per leave year. The leave year runs from 1 April to 31 March. Casual leave is meant for short, personal and often unplanned needs, such as a family errand or a personal appointment.

Rules:

- A single casual leave request can cover at most **3 consecutive working days**. For a longer absence, use earned leave.
- Half-day casual leave is allowed and counts as 0.5 day.
- Casual leave does **not** carry over. Unused days lapse on 31 March and are not paid out.
- Joiners get a pro-rated entitlement: 8 days multiplied by the months remaining in the leave year divided by 12, rounded up to the nearest half day.
- Casual leave cannot be attached directly before or after earned leave for a total of more than 3 consecutive days off, unless your manager approves.

Casual leave needs your manager's approval, ideally 2 working days ahead. In a genuine emergency you can apply on the same day, but you must tell your manager by 10:00. Apply in the people portal at https://people.smartdesk.example under **Leave**; the steps are in HR-LEAVE-04 (Apply for leave in the people portal).

Casual leave is available from your first day, including during probation.

[HR-PERF-02] Rating scale and promotions
Performance is rated on a **5-point scale**:

1. **Needs improvement:** below the expected standard; a performance plan is agreed.
2. **Partially meets:** meets some of the goals, with clear gaps.
3. **Meets expectations:** reliable performance against the goals. Most employees are here.
4. **Exceeds expectations:** goes beyond the goals in scope or impact.
5. **Outstanding:** exceptional results that lift the whole team or business.

Ratings are calibrated across each department so that managers apply the same standard. As a guide, about 3% of employees get a 1, 7% a 2, 55% a 3, 28% a 4 and 7% a 5 (100% in total), but this is a guide, not a quota.

**Salary and bonus.** The rating feeds into the annual increase and the variable bonus. A rating of 1 or 2 usually means no increase.

**Promotions.** Promotions are considered twice a year, with effect from **1 April** and **1 October**. To be considered you need at least 12 months in your current role, a rating of 4 or above in the last cycle, and the nomination of your manager with supporting evidence. A nomination goes to a promotion panel for the department. Employees cannot nominate themselves, but can discuss their ambition with their manager at any time.

A promotion is confirmed with a letter in the people portal.

SmartDesk AI provides paid maternity leave on full pay to employees who give birth.

- **First and second child:** **26 weeks**. Up to 8 of those weeks can be taken before the expected delivery date, and the rest after.
- **Third child onward:** **12 weeks**, of which up to 6 weeks can be taken before the expected delivery date.
- **Miscarriage or medical termination of pregnancy:** **6 weeks**, starting from the date it happens, with a medical certificate.

2. Apply under **Leave**, then **Maternity** in the people portal at https://people.smartdesk.example and upload the medical certificate with the expected delivery date.

[HR-ABOUT-01] About SmartDesk AI
SmartDesk AI is a business-to-business software company, founded in 2016, that builds supply-chain analytics tools for manufacturers and retailers. It has about 450 employees. - **IT help desk:** extension 4100, https://helpdesk.smartdesk.example, h***@smartdesk.example. Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 20:00 IST.

[HR-LEAVE-07] Paternity and adoption leave
SmartDesk AI offers the following leave to parents who are not giving birth, and to adopting parents. Paternity leave, second-parent adoption leave and adoptive-father leave are **company policy** and not a statutory right.

- **Paternity leave:** **2 weeks** on full pay, for a new father or partner of the person giving birth. It can be taken in one block or split into two blocks, any time within **6 months of the child's birth**.
- **Adoption leave, primary caregiver:** **12 weeks** on full pay for the main caregiver of a child under 3 months old. This applies to adoptive mothers, commissioning mothers, and to adoptive fathers and same-gender parents who are the main caregiver. Adoptive fathers and same-gender parents receive this as company policy.
- **Adoption leave, second parent:** **2 weeks** on full pay, taken within 6 months of the adoption date, under the same rules as paternity leave. This is company policy.

How to apply: submit the request in the people portal at https://people.smartdesk.example under **Leave** and choose **Paternity** or **Adoption**. Upload the child's birth certificate or adoption order. Give at least 4 weeks' notice of your intended dates where possible.

Only one parent at SmartDesk AI can claim primary caregiver adoption leave for the same child. If both parents work here, they choose who is the primary caregiver and the other takes second-parent leave. Questions go to the People Team on extension 4200.

[IT-PWD-02] Password rules and expiry
SmartDesk AI passwords must:

- be at least **14 characters** long (a passphrase of several unrelated words is fine and easier to remember);
- not repeat any of your last 10 passwords;
- not contain your name, employee ID or work email address;
- not appear on the blocked list of commonly used passwords, which the reset page checks automatically.

Passwords expire every **180 days**. You get reminder emails 14 days and 3 days before expiry, and a sign-in banner in the final week. You can change the password early at any time at https://id.smartdesk.example/reset. After 5 wrong attempts the account locks for 15 minutes.

**What not to do.** Do not share your password with anyone, including IT staff; the help desk will never ask for it, by phone or email. Do not reuse your work password on any other website. A password manager is recommended; the approved one is available in the Software Centre.

If you think your password has been seen by someone else, reset it immediately and tell Security on extension 4999. Do not wait for it to expire.

[HR-WFH-01] Hybrid schedule and core office days
SmartDesk AI works a hybrid model. The core office days are **Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday** in the Bengaluru or Pune office. You may work from home on **up to 2 days a week** without special approval, normally Monday and Friday.

Expectations when working from home:

- **Availability:** be reachable on chat, phone and email during the core hours of **10:00 to 17:00 IST**. Join scheduled meetings by video.
- **Devices and data:** use only your company laptop for company work. Personal devices must not be used to open sensitive company data. Connect to the VPN for internal systems.
- **Your workplace:** work from a place where you can keep company information private, and be able to take calls without being overheard.
- **Absence:** for planned leave, tell your manager and record it in the people portal. For an unplanned absence, such as an emergency, tell your manager as early as possible.
- **Breaks:** take short breaks away from your screen through the day and manage your workload with your manager. If work is affecting your health, the People Team can help in confidence.

**If the policy is not followed.** Repeated non-compliance is handled in steps: a verbal warning, then a written warning, and for continued breaches further action under the code of conduct. A single missed day is normally resolved with a conversation.

Managers can ask a team to come in on other days for planning or customer needs, with at least 2 working days' notice.

Question: can I use the VPN on my personal laptop?

Context:
[IT-VPN-03] When the VPN is required, and split tunnelling
The VPN is **required** whenever you are off the SmartDesk AI office network and need an internal system: the code repositories, the finance and HR portals, internal file shares or customer data. It is **not** needed for email, chat or video calls, which are reachable directly after MFA.

The VPN uses **split tunnelling**. Only traffic for company systems goes through the tunnel; streaming and general browsing use your own connection. This keeps calls smooth and does not reduce security for company data.

Interpretation points:

- If you are on a home or coworking network and are unsure whether a system needs the VPN, assume it does. Connecting when it is not needed does no harm.
- Using the VPN does not make a personal device acceptable. Company data may only be opened on company-managed laptops, whatever the connection.
- Turning the VPN off while customer data is open, for example to join a call, is not permitted. Close the data first.
- Inside the Bengaluru and Pune offices you are on the corporate network already, so the VPN is not needed. It is harmless but will slow your connection.
- On public Wi-Fi such as airports, connect to the VPN before opening anything internal.
- Idle VPN sessions end automatically after 8 hours, so reconnect at the start of each working day.

Questions about a specific system go to IT Security at s***@smartdesk.example.

[IT-WIFI-02] Corporate Wi-Fi networks and which to use
In both the Bengaluru and Pune offices there are two Wi-Fi networks:

- **SmartDesk-Secure** is for company laptops. It signs you in automatically with your work account and a device certificate, and gives access to internal systems without the VPN.
- **SmartDesk-Guest** is for visitors and personal phones.

Personal phones can use **SmartDesk-Guest** after self-registering with the employee's work email at https://helpdesk.smartdesk.example/wifi. Registration lasts 90 days and can be renewed on the same page. Personal devices cannot join SmartDesk-Secure.

**Common problems.**

- If SmartDesk-Secure keeps asking for a password after you changed your account password, forget the network on your laptop and rejoin it.
- If the laptop connects but has no internet, disconnect and reconnect once, then restart the laptop.
- If you see a certificate warning, do not accept it; raise a request, because it may mean an impostor network with a similar name.

Wi-Fi speed problems in a particular office area should be reported through the portal with the floor and the nearest meeting-point landmark, so IT can check the access point.

[IT-VPN-01] Install and configure the VPN client
SmartDesk AI uses the **SmartDesk Connect** VPN client on company laptops. It is preinstalled; if it is missing, install it from the Software Centre.

1. Open **SmartDesk Connect**.
2. In **Server**, enter `vpn.smartdesk.example`. On managed laptops the profile "SmartDesk-Corp" is already set up and you only need to select it.
3. Sign in with your work email and password.
4. Approve the MFA prompt in SmartDesk Authenticator, or enter the 6-digit code.
5. The status turns green and shows "Connected". Internal sites such as https://people.smartdesk.example and the file shares now work.

To disconnect, choose **Disconnect** in the client; closing the window leaves the tunnel running.

The client is available for Windows, macOS and Ubuntu. Personal devices cannot be given VPN access, and you should not install the client on one even if it installs without error.

If the profile is missing after an update, choose **Add profile**, use the server name above and the profile name "SmartDesk-Corp". If the client asks for a certificate, restart the laptop once so the company certificate loads, then try again.

[IT-EQUIP-01] What equipment a new joiner receives
Every new employee receives the following on or before day one:

- a company laptop (a 14-inch standard model, or a 16-inch high-performance model for engineering and data roles);
- a power adapter and carry sleeve;
- a USB-C docking station;
- a wireless keyboard and mouse;
- a managed user account, with access to SmartDesk Authenticator for multi-factor authentication.

The laptop arrives with disk encryption, the VPN client and the standard software already installed, so you can sign in and start working.

**How it is arranged.** The People Team confirms your start date to IT at least 5 working days ahead, and IT prepares the kit. On day one you collect it from the IT counter on the ground floor (Bengaluru) or the IT store (Pune). Remote employees outside these cities receive the same kit by courier; the tracking details are sent to the personal email address you gave when accepting the offer.

If your role needs a different laptop model, for example for specialised data work, your manager requests it before your start date at https://helpdesk.smartdesk.example.

Contractors receive a laptop only when their contract says so. Equipment stays the property of SmartDesk AI and must be returned when you leave.

[IT-VPN-02] Fixing common VPN connection errors
Try these in order. The numbered codes are Windows error codes shown by SmartDesk Connect on Windows laptops; macOS and Ubuntu show the same causes in plain text.

1. **"Authentication failed" (Windows error 691).** Your password may have expired or been changed recently. Reset it at https://id.smartdesk.example/reset and then update the password saved in the client.
2. **The MFA prompt never arrives.** Check that your phone has internet access, then open SmartDesk Authenticator manually and type the 6-digit code instead.
3. **"Server unreachable" (Windows error 809).** First confirm that other websites load on your connection. Some public and hotel networks block VPN traffic; switch to a mobile hotspot.
4. **Connected but internal sites do not load.** Disconnect, quit SmartDesk Connect completely, and connect again. Then clear your browser cache.
5. **The VPN drops after about 10 minutes.** Update the client in the Software Centre. Versions below 5.2 have a known session timeout bug.

If you see a certificate error, restart the laptop once and try again.

If none of these work, raise a request at https://helpdesk.smartdesk.example. Attach a screenshot of the error and note the time it happened, so IT can find the matching entry in the VPN logs.

Question: What is the process to report harassment?

Context:
[HR-HARASS-02] Report harassment and what happens next
You can report in any of these ways:

- Email the People Team at p***@smartdesk.example, or the Internal Complaints Committee at i***@smartdesk.example.
- Call the People Team on extension 4200.
- Use the confidential form at https://people.smartdesk.example under **Raise a concern**. You can submit it without giving your name, though that can limit what the company can do.
- Speak to your manager or any senior leader, who must pass it on.

**What happens next.**

1. You receive an acknowledgement within **2 working days**.
2. A preliminary review checks whether the concern is serious enough for a formal investigation, normally within 10 working days.
3. If it is, a formal investigation is carried out by people with no link to the case. Both parties are heard and may bring a colleague for support.
4. The decision and any action are communicated within 90 days of the complaint. Interim steps, such as changing reporting lines, can be taken to protect you.

**Confidentiality and protection.** Details are shared only with those who need them. Retaliation is prohibited. If you think you are being punished for reporting, tell the People Team straight away; this is investigated separately.

Support such as counselling can be arranged through the People Team throughout the process.

[HR-COND-02] Gifts, entertainment and conflicts of interest
**Gifts and entertainment.** You may accept occasional gifts or hospitality from customers or suppliers only if they are modest and do not influence your decisions. Anything worth more than **₹3,000** must be reported in the people portal at https://people.smartdesk.example under **Compliance**, then **Gift register**, within 5 working days. Cash and cash equivalents may never be accepted. Never offer or accept anything in return for a favour: bribery is prohibited, whether in India or abroad.

**If you cannot decline.** If refusing a gift would cause offence because of local custom, you may accept it but must report it. Compliance decides whether you keep it, whether it is shared with your team, or whether it is returned or donated.

**Exceptions.** Any exception to this policy needs **prior written approval** from the Compliance Officer at c***@smartdesk.example.

**Conflicts of interest.** A conflict exists when a personal interest could affect your judgement at work. Examples are owning part of a supplier or customer, employing a relative in your own team, or working for a competitor. You must disclose these in writing to your manager and the Compliance Officer as soon as you know. Outside work or side businesses need written approval first; you may not work for a competitor or use company time or equipment.

If unsure, ask Compliance. Failure to report is treated more seriously than the gift or interest itself. Concerns can also be raised through the process in HR-HARASS-02 (Report harassment and what happens next).

[HR-HARASS-01] Anti-harassment policy
SmartDesk AI does not tolerate harassment of any kind. This includes sexual harassment, discrimination and bullying, whether it takes place in the office, at home, at a customer site, on a trip, by message or on a video call.

Examples of unacceptable behaviour:

- unwelcome physical contact, comments, jokes or messages of a sexual nature;
- remarks or conduct based on gender, caste, religion, disability, age, marital status, sexual orientation or background;
- repeated shouting, humiliation, exclusion or spreading rumours;
- showing or sending offensive material.

What the company does:

- every employee completes **Anti-Harassment Awareness** within 14 days of joining and again each year;
- an **Internal Complaints Committee** receives and investigates complaints on sexual harassment, and the People Team deals with other forms;
- retaliation against anyone who complains in good faith, or who helps an investigation, is itself serious misconduct.

You do not need proof or a witness to raise a concern. Managers who learn of a possible incident must report it to the People Team within 24 hours, even if the employee asks them not to.

How to report a complaint is covered in HR-HARASS-02 (Report harassment and what happens next). Substantiated complaints lead to action from a formal warning up to dismissal, depending on severity.

[HR-ONB-01] Day-one checklist
Your first day starts at 09:30 at reception in the Bengaluru or Pune office. Remote joiners join a video orientation at 10:00 IST; the link is in the welcome email sent 3 working days before your start date.

On day one, work through this list:

1. Meet the People Team (extension 4200) to sign your contract documents, the confidentiality agreement and the code of conduct acknowledgement.
2. Hand in your bank details and tax details in the people portal at https://people.smartdesk.example, so that your first salary is not delayed.
3. Collect your laptop and kit from the IT counter, or unpack the courier delivery if you are remote. See IT-EQUIP-01 (What equipment a new joiner receives).
4. Sign in to your laptop, then set up multi-factor authentication at https://id.smartdesk.example/mfa.
5. Install Outlook on your phone if you want work email there.
6. Meet your manager for the first-week plan, and meet your buddy.
7. Start the two mandatory courses in the people portal: Security Awareness (about 45 minutes) and Anti-Harassment Awareness (about 30 minutes). Both must be finished within 14 days.

**If something is missing.** If your laptop is not ready, call IT on extension 4100; you can start with orientation and collect it later in the day. If you cannot sign in to the people portal, ask the People Team to resend your temporary password.

Your benefits enrolment window opens on day one and closes after 30 days. Do not leave it to the last week.

[HR-WFH-03] Working from abroad
Working from another country is **not allowed without prior written approval** from both the People Team and Legal. This covers working remotely during a personal trip.

If approved, the limit is **15 working days per leave year** in a single country, and approval is given case by case.

Process:

1. Request at least **15 working days before** you plan to travel, through **Work location request** in the people portal at https://people.smartdesk.example. Choose **Outside India**.
2. State the country, the dates and the reason.
3. The People Team checks tax, payroll and your right to work there; Legal checks data protection and customer contracts. IT Security checks that you will have a safe connection.
4. You receive the decision in writing. If it is a refusal, the reason is explained.

Interpretation points:

- Working a few hours of email while on holiday abroad still counts as working from abroad if you do it as part of your job.
- Some customer contracts and some countries prohibit access to certain data from outside India. In that case approval is declined however short the stay.
- Time spent on approved leave is not working from abroad. If you are on leave, do not work.
- Working abroad without approval is a breach of the code of conduct, and the cost of any tax or legal problems arising may be recovered.
